title: Continuous coefficients along a compact-state progressive process
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib compact-state coefficient lemma, statement seal; Mathlib MemLp.of_bound provides the product-space bound.
target_statement: Let X be a jointly measurable, strongly progressive process taking values in a compact second-countable pseudometrizable Borel state space S. Let c be a continuous real function of nonnegative time and state. Then the coefficient evaluated along X is strongly progressive. For each finite nonnegative horizon its time section is integrable at every sample. With a finite sample measure, the sample-first product representative belongs to $L^p$ for every exponent p in the extended nonnegative reals.
